58.85: Subsequently, the learned person should wash his feet with clay and water. He should then do acamana thrice with pure water. He should sprinkle the water on the feet and head. The Brahmana should then do Pranayama thrice in the proper method, should sit facing east in concentration with kusa in the hands and giving up any laxity.
